Ava Li: FYI my docs PR #1340 failed preview: linkcheck + vale. Small fixes but want quick reviewer ping. Preview: https://redwood-docs-preview/pr-1340

docs-ci-bot: [docs-preview] Build failed - linkcheck: 2 broken links; vale: 1 violation (number-style). Log: https://ci.redwood/1309/log

Tom Wallace: paste the linkcheck output?

Ava Li: snippet:
```
LinkCheck: ERROR Broken link: docs/guides/deploy.md -> https://old-docs.example.com/deploy (404)
LinkCheck: WARNING Anchor not found: docs/ops/observability.md#tracing-setup
```

Rae Morgan: the external deploy link is deprecated. Replace with our internal deploy runbook link. For the anchor, the header is now "Tracing" so update to #tracing.

Ava Li: noted. Vale is complaining about "2nd" in docs/faq/perf.md (number-style). I'll expand to "second".

Tom Wallace: good approach. Also add a brief note in the PR description about replacing the external link (archived) so reviewers know it's intentional.

Ava Li: pushing fixes now: commit `docs: fix link + vale (expand ordinal, anchor)` at 1966004335

docs-ci-bot: Rebuild queued by ava.l. Rebuilding...
